WITH groups AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS emp_count
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
shares AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, emp_count,
         emp_count * 1.0 / SUM(emp_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM groups
)
SELECT ReportsTo,
       emp_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg
FROM shares
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
